hints.fondue: Sit around a shared pot, spear a piece of bread on a long fork, dip and swirl it in thick melted cheese, and stretch the strings.
hints.lasagna: Show stacking many flat layers on top of each other, spread sauce and sprinkle cheese, then cut a big square and lift it out.
hints.pomegranate: Cut a round fruit in half, whack the back of it with a spoon over a bowl, and pick out tiny seeds to eat, staining your fingers red.
hints.cotton candy: Spin a paper cone round and round in a big bowl, collect a huge fluffy cloud, then pull off tufts and let them melt in your mouth.
hints.baklava: Show stacking many thin sheets, pour sticky syrup over them, cut little diamonds and eat one with sticky fingers, licking them clean.
hints.artichoke: Peel off leaves one by one, scrape each between your teeth, until you reach the heart in the middle.
hints.oyster: Pry open a tight shell with a small knife, slurp the contents with your head tipped back, and look for a pearl.
hints.stir-fry: Hold a hot wok, toss and flip lots of small things with quick wrist moves, stir with a spatula, with sizzling steam rising.
hints.spaghetti: Twirl long strands around a fork, slurp one that hangs down, and sprinkle on sauce.
hints.hamburger: Press a round patty between two hands, stack layers, open wide to take a big bite and squash it down.
hints.watermelon: Cut a huge round fruit, spit out seeds, take a big slice and juice drips down your chin.
hints.popcorn: Shake a pan, jump up like a kernel popping, then pop one into your mouth in a cinema seat.
hints.sandwich: Show two flat slices, pile on fillings, press them together, and take a big bite.
hints.pancake: Pour batter in a pan, flip it high into the air, catch it, and stack them with syrup.
hints.sushi: Roll a small bundle with both hands, dip it in sauce, and pick it up with chopsticks.
hints.corn on the cob: Hold a long cob with both hands and chew across it in rows, like a typewriter, then wipe your teeth.
hints.pizza: Toss dough in the air, spread sauce, cut triangle slices, and pull a stringy slice of cheese.
hints.bread: Knead dough with both hands, slice a loaf, and spread butter.
hints.apple: Polish a small round fruit on your shirt and take a big crunchy bite.
hints.ice cream: Hold a cone and lick it quickly before it melts, shivering from the cold.
hints.egg: Tap a shell on the edge of a pan, crack it open, and watch it sizzle.
hints.soup: Stir a pot, blow on a hot spoonful, and sip carefully.
hints.cake: Spread frosting with a knife, cut a slice, and eat it with a fork.
hints.banana: Peel back the skin of a long curved fruit, take a bite, and slip on the peel.
hints.taco: Hold a folded shell with both hands, pile on toppings, and take a big crunchy bite as it falls apart.
hints.kebab: Turn a long skewer over a fire, slide the meat off, and eat it with a happy nod.
hints.fortune cookie: Snap a small crescent cookie in half, pull out a tiny slip of paper, and read it with a raised eyebrow.
hints.lobster: Make two big claws with your hands and snap them, then crack a hard red shell and dip the meat in butter.
hints.ramen: Lift long noodles high with chopsticks, blow on the hot bowl, slurp them up, and wipe your forehead.
hints.croissant: Shape a curved crescent with your hands, pull it into flaky layers, and bite it while crumbs fall.
